name: Uncle Frank's Pizza & Cocktails
aliases: Uncle Frank's Wood Fired Pizza & Cocktails
description: A wood-fired pizza and cocktail restaurant next to the Wantagh train station. It has live music on Thursday nights, mostly singers, duos and small bands, and bands play outside during Wantagh's summer Thursday Night Live street events on Railroad Avenue.

dancing.notes: Indoors this is a sit-down dining room, and reviewers describe it as fairly quiet and relaxing, with live music on Thursdays. We found no dance floor or reports of dancing. The summer street events outside have more room, but we could not confirm dancing there either.

evidence.note: Venue music page lists dated performers, mostly on Thursdays, from October into late November 2026.
Review summary calls the dining room semi-quiet and relaxing, with live music on Thursdays.
